'''Help Complete the Archive''' is the starting point for anyone who wants to add to the Star Wars CCG wiki. It shows what the archive already holds, what was solved most recently, and the open cases where one memory, one photograph or one old file can settle a question. Every case links to its list; the full index of open questions, with sources, is [[Mysteries]].

== How to help in a minute ==
<div style="display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:1em; align-items:flex-start; margin:0.5em 0 1em 0;">
<div style="flex:0 1 260px; text-align:center;">[[File:2025 World Championship Summer shirt table 4 October evening.jpg|260px|link=2025 World Championship|Players at a table at the 2025 World Championship]]</div>
<div style="flex:1 1 280px; min-width:240px;">
# '''Tell someone.''' Post on the [https://swccg.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=4 General board] of the [https://swccg.com/forum/ SWCCG Forum]. Name the case (for example "2023 group photograph, no. 20") and say how you know. A wiki editor adds the answer with you as the source.
# '''Write on the Talk page.''' With a swccg.com account, add a comment on [[Talk:Help Complete the Archive]] or on the Talk page of the article, File or list where the case sits.
# '''Send the file.''' Old photographs, score sheets, tournament packets, slip-sheet PDFs and newsletters are all welcome. A phone photo of a printed page is enough to start. Post it on the [https://swccg.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=4 General board] with the event name and year.
# '''Edit it yourself.''' Editors can add a name, a result or a source directly; [[Template:Mystery]] flags an open question in an article, and [[Template:Help wanted]] invites help on an event page.

First-hand accounts are accepted sources on this wiki and are cited as personal communication (see [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide]]).
</div>
</div>
